entries.en: Our workers discovered a vast body of water while excavating an underground cave, and found it absolutely teeming with fish. This blessing will provide a steady supply of sustenance as we dig deeper. That is, of course, if we can catch the fish.
entries.fr: Profondeurs des cavernes abriter lac ! Incroyable incroyable ! Devoir fournir à explorateuuurs matériel de pêche pour pouvoir manger pendant travail !
entries.ja:
地下の洞窟で見つかった地底湖に、魚がおりましたそうで～。
作業を進める発掘隊が、現地で食料を調達できるように、
釣具を用意したいと考えておりまする～！

entries.en: A lure made from animal bones should prove irresistible, and the Husk has no shortage of desiccated remains. My workers and I would be grateful if you could bring some to us.
entries.fr: Avoir besoin d'os d'animal pour fabriquer canne !  extraire  de haute qualité près de Coquille brisée !
entries.ja:
ルアーを作るため、動物の骨を調達いただけませぬでしょか～？
割れた宝卵付近で、「」が採れまする～。
すみませぬが、3つほどご協力よろしくお願いいたしまする～！

entries.en: Worms would make ideal bait, but only the most plump and juicy will do. Those in the Husk are fat from feasting on the remains littering the area. My workers and I would be grateful if you would bring us some─for the fish, of course, not for us!
entries.fr: Avoir besoin de vers pour appâter poissons !  récolter  de haute qualité près de Coquille brisée !

entries.en: Fish can't well resist a plump, juicy bug at the end of a hook, but a simple fruit worm won't do if we wish to catch the most succulent fish. However, a fruit worm may suffice to catch what we need. Go to Mjrl's Regret with fruit worm on hook, and bring us back a splendid larva.

entries.en: You've outdone yourself once again! Until now, we've been subsisting on preserved food. It fills our bellies, but I'm of the philosophy that a meal is meant to be savored. Perhaps finally we can forget the fact that we're toiling away under the earth, if even just for one meal.
entries.fr: Enfants être contents contents ! Nourriture en conserve perdre goût avec temps, alors pouvoir manger poisson frais chaque jour changer vie ! Oui oui oui !
entries.ja:
ご協力、誠にありがとうございまする～！
保存食ばかりでは味気がないものでございますから、
新鮮な食材を地下で調達できることは、嬉しゅうございまする～！
